purpose: Governed Schema Catalog input for a future SQLBot phase; SQLBot is disabled in DATA-4.1.

data_classification_taxonomy.OPEN_SOURCE_REAL_DATA: direct fields from approved ACN/UCI snapshots
data_classification_taxonomy.OPEN_SOURCE_DERIVED: deterministic derivations from approved public-source records
data_classification_taxonomy.BUSINESS_ASSUMPTION: explicit approved business assumptions such as the UCI 70 percent cost rule
data_classification_taxonomy.TEST_FIXTURE: legacy deterministic seed rows retained only for tests and rollback
